errors.description: The button placket itself carries NO stitching at all, and the one stitch line in the frame sits on the far side of the placket's shadowed free edge, on a separate cloth layer. Per-column analysis over y=350-410 finds exactly one periodic (dashed/perforated) column pair at x=482-483 (sd 10.5 against a 2-4 background); the entire placket face from x=272 to x=417 shows sd 1.8-4.0 with no periodic modulation, i.e. no needle penetration anywhere on it. The hard luminance step at x=417 (mean falls 207 -> 163 in two columns, then recovers gradually to x=471) is a free cloth edge casting a shadow to its right, so the stitch at x=482 lies on the layer beneath, roughly 0.85 cm outboard of the placket edge. Buttons sit at x=340, centred in the 1.9 cm placket band.
errors.expected: One fine topstitch line ON the placket, inboard of the button line, with the centre-front placket edge left as a clean unstitched fold. In the drawing (589 px wide) the solid red front edge is at x=217, the button centres at x=233, and the single dashed red stitch line at x=255 - so the order across the placket is edge, then buttons, then stitch, all on one continuous surface.
errors.actual: Placket face entirely unstitched; the only stitch line lies across a shadowed cloth step, about 0.85 cm beyond the placket's free edge and about 2.7 cm from the button centreline, on a different plane from the buttons.
errors.correction: Put the single topstitch line on the same surface as the buttons, inboard of them, with no cloth edge or shadow step between the buttons and the stitch.

errors.description: Button-to-edge relationship does not match the drawing. Scaling by the rendered button diameter (85 px = 1.1 cm, so 1 cm = 77 px), the buttons sit 0.88 cm from the left crease and 1.0 cm from the right free edge - centred in the band. The drawing sets the buttons hard against the front edge with the stitch line well inboard (edge-to-button 0.88 cm, edge-to-stitch 2.09 cm, a 2.4:1 ratio).
errors.expected: Buttons close to the clean front edge, single stitch line clearly inboard, ratio of edge-to-stitch versus edge-to-button of about 2.4:1.
errors.actual: Buttons centred in a plain band bounded by a soft crease on one side and a shadowed free edge on the other, with no stitch line on that band at all.
errors.correction: Reproduce the drawn offsets: button centre about 0.9 cm from the clean front fold, single stitch line about 2.1 cm from it.

errors.description: The drawing's defining lower-front context is gone. It shows the placket running down to a square termination, the curved shirt-tail hem sweeping away, and the side seam/gusset detail at the hem. The candidate is a tight mid-placket macro containing three buttons, no placket termination, no hem and no gusset.
errors.expected: Lower front of the shirt: placket run, its termination, and the curved shirt-tail hem, per the illustration's extent.
errors.actual: Mid-run macro crop; hem, placket end and gusset all outside the frame.
errors.correction: Include the placket termination and the start of the curved hem as the lower boundary while keeping the stitch line large enough to read.

errors.description: The 0.1 cm specification cannot be demonstrated by this image. The stitch gauge itself is credibly fine (dash pitch about 4-5 px, roughly 7 stitches per cm at the measured scale), but 0.1 cm is a distance from a folded edge, and there is no folded edge adjacent to the stitch line at x=482 - only flat cloth. I did not verify the 0.1 cm offset; it is not resolvable in this frame.
errors.expected: Stitch set 0.1 cm from the inner placket fold, with that fold readable in frame so the offset is demonstrable.
errors.actual: Fine even stitch on flat cloth with no adjacent folded edge to measure from.
errors.correction: Show the folded edge the stitch follows, so the 0.1 cm offset is visible.
